title: Implement surjective FpGroup kernel computation helper
description: Add a helper method `_surjective_fp_kernel` to the GroupHomomorphism class that computes the kernel for surjective homomorphisms between FpGroups. According to group theory, for a surjective homomorphism φ: G → H where G and H are FpGroups, the kernel is generated by lifts (preimages) of the relators of H. The method should: (1) Get the relators of the codomain FpGroup using self.codomain.relators, (2) For each relator r, compute its preimage using self.invert(r), (3) Collect these preimages as kernel generators, (4) Return an FpSubgroup of the domain generated by these preimages with normal=True.
expected_output: A new method `_surjective_fp_kernel(self)` in the GroupHomomorphism class that returns an FpSubgroup representing the kernel for surjective FpGroup homomorphisms. The method signature should be `def _surjective_fp_kernel(self):` and it should return `FpSubgroup(self.domain, kernel_gens, normal=True)`.
